title: A MILLION VIEWS FOR ONE PHOTO: IRAOLA AT A KIDS' GRASSROOTS MATCH
description:
Most managers argue with the officials. Iraola became one.

One photo, two kids, one million views. Andoni Iraola went to a junior match in Maghull, reportedly to watch a relative, and posed with the children. Maghull manager Joe Burns says he spent a long time with them, and the internet did the rest.

It isn't his first turn at grassroots level. Earlier this year, still at Bournemouth, he ran the line as an assistant referee at a local match. Fans are calling him down-to-earth, and a million views suggest they're right. Best title of the season, and no trophy needed.

Would you want your manager turning up at your grassroots game? Yes or no?
